reservedImportAlias.comment: An `as`-aliased import/export binding (`import { name as document }`, `import { document as alias }`). The host JS grammar matches `name as alias` as one span, so the #reservedNames rule below can't reach an aliased stdlib name on its own; we re-tokenize each side through #reservedNames so a stdlib name in either the imported or the local position still gets the storage.type.js highlight. Non-stdlib names fall through to their default scope. Listed before #reservedNames so it wins the whole `name as alias` span.

filePath.comment: filePath is a read-only global constant spruce injects with the input's absolute path, highlighted as a language variable rather than a stdlib function.
filePath.name: variable.language.filepath.spruce

reservedNames.comment: The stdlib functions spruce makes available by bare name inside declaration blocks. Highlighted with storage.type.js, the same scope TextMate gives the `constructor` keyword in a class, so they read as language-reserved both where they're defined (function bold) and where they're called. Injected across the whole embedded JS block (L: priority) so it also wins inside function bodies and over the function-declaration name capture. Keep in sync with the keys in stdlib.js (the `$` and `_` entries are intentionally omitted, since highlighting every `$`/`_` would be far too noisy). Longer names precede their prefixes so e.g. `codeBlock` wins over `code`.
reservedNames.name: storage.type.js
